description: This file defines the ReportingMethodConfigurationService class responsible for managing reporting methods within the HRM system. It provides methods for CRUD operations, querying, and normalization related to reporting methods.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationService
classes.description: Service class providing operations related to reporting methods, including CRUD, list retrieval, counting, and normalization.

methods.name: getReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Returns the instance of ReportingMethodConfigurationDao, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Persists a ReportingMethod entity using the DAO.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Gets a list of reporting methods based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Counts reporting methods based on filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes reporting methods by their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a reporting method name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Returns IDs of reporting methods that are currently in use.

methods.name: getReportingMethodArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of reporting methods for external use.
